text:
anna_su: heads up — we have an active customer escalation. After last night's canary of redwood-v2.3.0 some customers are seeing function/tool calls fail with schema validation errors. customer-facing support ticket 89432.

anna_su: example error from logs:```json
{
  "error": "function_call_validation_failed",
  "details": "tool 'geo_lookup' expected args type object, got string for 'coords'"
}
```

anna_su: repro curl we used against hosted API (customer request id: req_0x7a9):```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2.3.0","input":"Find store for 94107","functions":[{"name":"geo_lookup","parameters":{"coords":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"}}}}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```

cheng_li: thanks anna — pinging infra and runtime. do we see this only on v2.3.0 canary or across variants?

anna_su: only reported on canary nodes so far (canary pool id cny-12). No reports on v2.2.x. latency also spiked on canary for function_call flows ~120ms -> 450ms for first token.

raja_patil: seeing increased `function_call_validation_failed` in telemetry for v2.3.0 starting at 1772496400. failure rate ~4.6% on canary. aggregate says the model is emitting args as JSON-encoded strings for some tool choices.

mike_oncall: that sounds like a model output-shape regression — maybe a decoding/prefix change. if it’s emitting strings instead of objects our validation layer rejects. workaround: we can accept JSON-encoded strings and attempt parse on the gateway for known tools temporarily. but that has risk.

cheng_li: can we get an example of the model raw output for a failing request? need the exact tokens.

anna_su: pasted snippet from request req_0x7a9 (raw model response):```json
{"id":"resp_...","choices":[{"function_call":{"name":"geo_lookup","arguments":"{\"coords\": \"[37.7749, -122.4194]\"}"}}]}
```

raja_patil: aha — arguments are a JSON string, not a JSON object. that aligns w/ tokenizer/formatter change in the new runtime kernel selection. likely a subtle change in how we serialize function arguments when using the new kernel.

deploy-bot: canary rollout redwood-v2.3.0 -> completed to cny-12 at 1772496000.

mike_oncall: customer SLA impacted. recommend rollback of canary to v2.2.8 while we patch serialization. + create an incident to track.

cheng_li: +1 rollback. also adding quick mitigation: gateway will attempt to parse stringified JSON for tools in the allowed list (geo_lookup, price_check) for next 15m while we roll back. i'll push a safe patch and feature-flag it.

anna_su: customer asked for immediate rollback, they depend on tool calls for product flow. i'll notify them we're rolling back and give ETA.

raja_patil: root cause hypothesis: kernel selection path introduced a formatting layer that wraps args as strings for certain sequence length / tokenization boundaries. fix plan: add unit that preserves argument objects at generation time + add more canary tests for function_call shape.

mike_oncall: ticket INC-2026-94 opened for rollback + followups. assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml. tagging @cheng_li and @raja_patil.

cheng_li: starting rollback: invoking deployment job to pin model pool cny-12 -> redwood-v2.2.8. logs:```text
[1772500105] rollback job triggered by cheng_li
[1772500142] draining canary traffic
[1772500201] deploying redwood-v2.2.8 to cny-12
[1772500289] health checks passing
```

anna_su: customer updated — they saw the rollback confirmation and will validate. will post customer acceptance here.

raja_patil: follow-ups: add an E2E test that forces function_call with nested arrays/objects, add model-output shape regression alerts, and add a schema-fuzz check during canary.

mike_oncall: marking support escalation as resolved after rollback completes and customer validates. will schedule postmortem with action items: tighter canary checks, gateway tolerant parsing for a short window, and a rollback playbook update.

anna_su: customer validated at 1772500345 — their flow works again on v2.2.8. closing the loop. :white_check_mark:

cheng_li: thanks everyone. following up w/ PRs for the patch and tests. :eyes:
